t: The Forge Charging Port allows you to use the energy stored in your $(l:bigreactors/passive)passively cooled$(/l) Reactor to charge items that use the Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors/powersystem)power system$(/l) to function. $(br2) Open the graphical interface of the port and insert the item you want charged into the input slot in the center.
Forge充能端口可以让你使用储存在$(l:bigreactors/passive)被动冷却$(/l)反应堆中的能量，为依赖 Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)运行的物品充能。$(br2)打开该端口的图形界面，然后将你想充能的物品放入中央的输入槽中。

Once the item’s energy buffer is full, it will be automatically moved to the interface output slot for you to collect. $(br2) If, for any reason, you need to stop the charging process, press the eject button to move the item to the output slot immediately.
当物品的能量缓冲区充满后，它会自动移动到界面的输出槽位，供你取出。$(br2)如果你因任何原因需要停止充能过程，按下弹出按钮即可立即将物品移到输出槽位。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
$(l)必需：$()否$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意面（不能在框架上）$(br)$(l)变种：$()全部$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()是
